passages.titleEn: Two-year-old with a night-time barking cough
passages.titleZh: 夜间出现犬吠样咳嗽的两岁幼儿

profile.chiefComplaintEn: Barking cough and noisy breathing that woke him at 02:00
profile.chiefComplaintZh: 凌晨 2 点被犬吠样咳嗽和呼吸杂音惊醒
profile.pastMedicalHxZh: 无既往病史；疫苗接种齐全
profile.firstVitalsEn: HR 148; RR 34; BP 92/60; SpO2 95% on room air; Temp 38.1°C; weight 12 kg
profile.firstVitalsZh: 心率 148 次/分；呼吸 34 次/分；血压 92/60 mmHg；室内空气下 SpO2 95%；体温 38.1°C；体重 12 kg
profile.physicalFindingsEn: Alert and consolable in his mother's arms; hoarse voice with inspiratory stridor when he cries; mild suprasternal indrawing; chest clear on auscultation; no drooling and no tripod positioning
profile.physicalFindingsZh: 神志清醒，在母亲怀里可被安抚；声音嘶哑，哭闹时出现吸气性喘鸣（stridor）；胸骨上窝轻度凹陷；双肺听诊清晰；无流涎，也没有三脚架体位
profile.otherInformationEn: Coryza and low-grade fever for two days; symptoms are clearly worse tonight than last night. No choking episode was witnessed and he has been eating and drinking normally.
profile.otherInformationZh: 流涕伴低热已两天，今晚症状明显比昨晚重。家属没有目击呛咳或异物吸入的过程，患儿进食饮水一直正常。

questions.questionEn: Which condition is this child most likely suffering from?
questions.questionZh: 这名患儿最可能患的是哪一种疾病？

options.en: Croup (laryngotracheobronchitis)
options.zh: 喉炎性哮吼（croup，即喉气管支气管炎）

options.en: Epiglottitis
options.zh: 会厌炎（epiglottitis）

options.en: Bronchiolitis
options.zh: 毛细支气管炎（bronchiolitis）

options.en: Foreign body airway obstruction
options.zh: 气道异物梗阻（foreign body airway obstruction）

questions.explanationEn: A barking cough with a hoarse voice, inspiratory stridor and a two-day history of coryza with a low-grade fever is the classic picture of croup. Epiglottitis is the near-miss distractor, but it typically brings a high fever, drooling, a muffled rather than hoarse voice and a toxic, tripod-sitting child — the profile explicitly states there is no drooling and no tripod positioning. Bronchiolitis produces expiratory wheeze and crackles rather than stridor, and the chest is clear here. A foreign body causes sudden onset in a previously well child; this child has been unwell for two days and is eating and drinking normally.
questions.explanationZh: 犬吠样咳嗽、声音嘶哑、吸气性喘鸣，再加上两天的流涕和低热，是喉炎性哮吼（croup）的典型表现。会厌炎（epiglottitis）是最接近的干扰项，但它通常表现为高热、流涎、声音发闷而非嘶哑，患儿呈明显中毒貌并采取三脚架体位；本例资料明确写了没有流涎、没有三脚架体位。毛细支气管炎产生的是呼气性哮鸣和湿啰音而不是喘鸣，而本例双肺听诊清晰。气道异物起病突然、发生在原本健康的孩子身上；本例已经不适两天，且进食饮水正常。
questions.sourceRef: BC Guidelines p.62 (Dexamethasone — croup); COPR Study Guide v4.2 sample profile 1

questions.questionEn: How should the paramedic conduct the physical assessment of this child?
questions.questionZh: 这名患儿的体格检查应该怎样进行？

options.en: Lay him supine on the stretcher and work through a systematic head-to-toe examination
options.zh: 让他仰卧在担架上，按顺序完成一次系统的头到脚检查

options.en: Inspect the oropharynx with a tongue depressor to visualize the epiglottis
options.zh: 用压舌板检查口咽部，以便直接观察会厌

options.en: Examine him toe-to-head while he stays sitting on his mother's lap, keeping him calm throughout
options.zh: 让他继续坐在母亲腿上，按从脚到头的顺序检查，全程保持他安静

options.en: Ask his mother to step outside so that he is not distracted during the assessment
options.zh: 请母亲到房间外面等，以免检查时分散患儿注意力

questions.explanationEn: In this age group the assessment is conducted toe-to-head so that the least threatening areas are touched first and the child's trust is gained. Crying and agitation increase turbulent airflow and worsen upper airway obstruction, so the child should be left in a position of comfort with the caregiver. Instrumenting the oropharynx of a child with stridor risks precipitating complete obstruction and is never done in the field. Separating him from his mother will only increase distress.
questions.explanationZh: 对这个年龄段的患儿，检查顺序应该是从脚到头，先接触威胁感最小的部位，逐步取得孩子的信任。哭闹和烦躁会加重气流紊乱，使上气道梗阻进一步恶化，所以应让孩子保持在最舒适的体位、留在照顾者身边。对有喘鸣的患儿用器械检查口咽部有诱发完全性梗阻的风险，院前绝不能做。把他和母亲分开只会让他更加不安。
questions.sourceRef: COPR Study Guide v4.2 sample profile 1; BC Guidelines p.11 (Primary Survey interventions)

questions.questionEn: Which medication and dose is indicated for this 12 kg child?
questions.questionZh: 对这名体重 12 kg 的患儿，应给予哪一种药物、剂量是多少？

options.en: Salbutamol 5 mg by nebulizer
options.zh: 沙丁胺醇（salbutamol）5 mg 雾化吸入

options.en: Dexamethasone 0.5 mg/kg PO — 6 mg for this child, mixed with juice if needed
options.zh: 地塞米松（dexamethasone）0.5 mg/kg 口服，本例为 6 mg，必要时可混入果汁改善口感

options.en: Epinephrine 0.5 mg IM
options.zh: 肾上腺素（epinephrine）0.5 mg 肌注

options.en: Ibuprofen 10 mg/kg PO
options.zh: 布洛芬（ibuprofen）10 mg/kg 口服

questions.explanationEn: Dexamethasone is indicated as adjunctive treatment for croup. The paediatric dose is 0.5 mg/kg IV/IO/IM/PO to a maximum of 16 mg, with the oral route preferred, and it may be combined with juice to improve palatability — 0.5 mg/kg x 12 kg = 6 mg. Salbutamol treats bronchospasm, which this child does not have; his chest is clear. Epinephrine 0.5 mg IM is the adult anaphylaxis dose and would be wrong twice over — the paediatric dose is 0.01 mg/kg (0.12 mg here) and the indication is anaphylaxis or severe bronchospasm, not croup. Ibuprofen would treat the fever but does nothing for the airway obstruction.
questions.explanationZh: 地塞米松（dexamethasone）是喉炎性哮吼（croup）的辅助治疗用药。儿童剂量为 0.5 mg/kg，可经 IV/IO/IM/PO 给药，最大 16 mg，首选口服，并可混入果汁改善口感——0.5 mg/kg × 12 kg = 6 mg。沙丁胺醇治疗的是支气管痉挛，而本例双肺听诊清晰，没有支气管痉挛。肾上腺素 0.5 mg 肌注是成人过敏性休克的剂量，在这里错了两层：儿童剂量应为 0.01 mg/kg（本例 0.12 mg），而且适应证是过敏性休克或严重支气管痉挛，不是哮吼。布洛芬能退热，但对气道梗阻毫无作用。
questions.sourceRef: BC Guidelines p.62 (Dexamethasone); p.66 (Epinephrine); p.68 (Ibuprofen); p.77 (Salbutamol)

questions.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management at this point?
questions.questionZh: 此时最恰当的处置是什么？

options.en: Remain on scene and observe until the dexamethasone takes effect before moving him
options.zh: 继续留在现场观察，等地塞米松起效之后再搬动他

options.en: Apply CPAP at 5 cmH2O to splint the upper airway open
options.zh: 给予 5 cmH2O 的 CPAP，用正压把上气道撑开

options.en: Insert an oropharyngeal airway and begin bag-valve-mask ventilation
options.zh: 置入口咽通气道并开始球囊面罩（BVM）通气

options.en: Apply high-flow oxygen, keep him upright and undisturbed on his mother's lap, and begin immediate transport with notification of the receiving hospital
options.zh: 给予高流量氧疗，让他保持坐位、留在母亲腿上尽量不受打扰，立即开始转运并提前通知接收医院

questions.explanationEn: Stridor at rest with falling saturations and marked indrawing is a deteriorating upper airway — this child is now unstable and needs oxygen, minimal handling and immediate transport with hospital notification. Option A is the classic wrong-priority trap: oral dexamethasone peaks at 1-2 hours, so waiting on scene for it to work simply delays definitive care. CPAP is contraindicated in patients 12 years of age and under. Inserting an OPA and ventilating over-treats a child who is still conscious and moving air, and would provoke the agitation that worsens the obstruction.
questions.explanationZh: 安静状态下出现喘鸣、血氧下降、凹陷征明显，说明上气道梗阻正在恶化——此时患儿已属不稳定，需要氧疗、尽量少搬动，并立即转运同时通知医院。选项 A 是典型的「优先级错误」陷阱：口服地塞米松要 1-2 小时才达峰，留在现场等它起效只会延误确定性治疗。CPAP 对 12 岁及以下患者属禁忌。置入口咽通气道并通气则是对一个仍然清醒、仍有气流的孩子过度治疗，而且必然引发烦躁，反而加重梗阻。
questions.sourceRef: BC Guidelines p.7 (unstable findings); p.50 (Oxygen Administration); p.52 (CPAP contraindications); p.62 (Dexamethasone onset)
questions.evolutionEn: On reassessment ten minutes later the child has stridor at rest, has become quiet and pale, his SpO2 has fallen to 89% on room air, and suprasternal and intercostal indrawing is now marked.
questions.evolutionZh: 十分钟后复评：患儿在安静状态下也出现喘鸣，人变得安静、面色苍白，室内空气下 SpO2 降至 89%，胸骨上窝和肋间凹陷已经非常明显。

passages.titleEn: 82-year-old woman with sudden weakness and nausea
passages.titleZh: 突发乏力伴恶心的 82 岁女性

profile.chiefComplaintEn: Sudden weakness, nausea and shortness of breath that began 40 minutes ago while she was making tea
profile.chiefComplaintZh: 40 分钟前正在泡茶时突然出现乏力、恶心和气促
profile.pastMedicalHxZh: 2 型糖尿病、高血压、骨关节炎
profile.medicationsZh: 二甲双胍、雷米普利（ramipril），必要时服用对乙酰氨基酚
profile.firstVitalsEn: HR 96 and irregular; RR 22; BP 138/86; SpO2 93% on room air; Temp 36.6°C; BGL 8.2 mmol/L
profile.firstVitalsZh: 心率 96 次/分且不规则；呼吸 22 次/分；血压 138/86 mmHg；室内空气下 SpO2 93%；体温 36.6°C；血糖 8.2 mmol/L
profile.physicalFindingsEn: Pale, cool and clammy; alert and fully oriented; denies any chest pain; lungs clear to auscultation; no peripheral edema
profile.physicalFindingsZh: 面色苍白、皮肤湿冷；神志清醒、定向力完整；否认任何胸痛；双肺听诊清晰；下肢无水肿
profile.otherInformationEn: She says she felt 'wrung out' climbing the stairs yesterday. She has taken nothing for this episode and has no known allergies. She apologizes repeatedly for calling and says she is sure it is only her sugar.
profile.otherInformationZh: 她说昨天上楼梯时就觉得「整个人被拧干了一样」。这次发作她没有吃任何药，也没有已知的药物过敏史。她反复为叫救护车道歉，说自己肯定只是血糖的问题。

questions.questionEn: Which finding most strongly suggests an acute coronary syndrome despite the complete absence of chest pain?
questions.questionZh: 尽管患者完全没有胸痛，哪一项发现最提示急性冠脉综合征（acute coronary syndrome）？

options.en: Her blood glucose of 8.2 mmol/L
options.zh: 血糖 8.2 mmol/L

options.en: Sudden weakness with nausea, diaphoresis and shortness of breath, preceded by exertional fatigue yesterday
options.zh: 突发乏力伴恶心、出冷汗和气促，且昨天活动后已出现明显疲乏

options.en: Her history of osteoarthritis treated with acetaminophen
options.zh: 有骨关节炎病史并服用对乙酰氨基酚

options.en: Her blood pressure of 138/86 mmHg
options.zh: 血压 138/86 mmHg

questions.explanationEn: Elderly patients and people with diabetes frequently present with anginal equivalents rather than chest pain — weakness, nausea, diaphoresis and dyspnea, often with exertional symptoms in the preceding days. The BC guidelines make this explicit by listing 'chest pain or atypical symptoms consistent with cardiac ischemia' as the indication for Aspirin. A blood glucose of 8.2 mmol/L is only mildly elevated and does not explain pallor and diaphoresis; osteoarthritis and a blood pressure of 138/86 are unremarkable background findings.
questions.explanationZh: 老年患者和糖尿病患者常常不以胸痛起病，而是表现为「心绞痛等价症状」——乏力、恶心、出冷汗和呼吸困难，并且在此前几天常有活动后不适。BC 考纲把这一点写得很明确：阿司匹林的适应证是「胸痛，或与心肌缺血相符的不典型症状」。血糖 8.2 mmol/L 只是轻度升高，无法解释面色苍白和出冷汗；骨关节炎和 138/86 mmHg 的血压都只是无关紧要的背景信息。
questions.sourceRef: BC Guidelines p.47 (Cardiac Chest Pain); p.60 (Aspirin indication)

questions.questionEn: She has no Aspirin allergy, has not taken Aspirin today, has no history of peptic ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding, and can swallow. How should Aspirin be given?
questions.questionZh: 该患者不对阿司匹林过敏，今天没有服用过阿司匹林，没有消化性溃疡或消化道出血史，吞咽功能正常。阿司匹林应该怎样给？

options.en: Withhold Aspirin, because she has not complained of chest pain
options.zh: 不给阿司匹林，因为她并没有主诉胸痛

options.en: 160 mg PO, but only once a full baseline set of vital signs has been recorded
options.zh: 160 mg 口服，但必须先记录完整的基线生命体征后才能给

options.en: 325 mg chewed and swallowed
options.zh: 325 mg 嚼碎后咽下

options.en: 160 mg chewed and swallowed, given after the rapid body survey
options.zh: 160 mg 嚼碎后咽下，在快速体格检查（RBS）之后给

questions.explanationEn: The BC dose is 160 mg PO, chewed and swallowed so that absorption begins within 20 minutes to an hour, and the guideline states that ASA should be given after the rapid body survey. Option A misreads the indication — atypical symptoms consistent with cardiac ischemia qualify. Option B is the near-miss: Aspirin is specifically noted as the only medication for which vital signs are not required prior to administration, so making it wait for a full baseline set introduces an unnecessary delay. Option C is the wrong dose for BC.
questions.explanationZh: BC 的剂量是 160 mg 口服，嚼碎后咽下，这样 20 分钟到 1 小时内就能起效；考纲还写明阿司匹林应在快速体格检查（RBS）之后给。选项 A 误读了适应证——与心肌缺血相符的不典型症状同样是适应证。选项 B 是最接近的干扰项：考纲特别指出阿司匹林是唯一一种给药前不要求先测生命体征的药，硬要等完整基线生命体征只会带来不必要的延误。选项 C 的剂量不符合 BC 标准。
questions.sourceRef: BC Guidelines p.47 (Cardiac Chest Pain); p.60 (Aspirin monograph)

questions.questionEn: Her partner asks whether nitroglycerin should be given now. What is the most appropriate action?
questions.questionZh: 她的伴侣问现在是不是该给硝酸甘油。最恰当的处理是什么？

options.en: Withhold nitroglycerin because the systolic blood pressure is now below 110 mmHg; continue oxygen, monitoring and transport
options.zh: 不给硝酸甘油，因为收缩压已低于 110 mmHg；继续氧疗、监护并转运

options.en: Give 0.4 mg nitroglycerin SL and reassess the blood pressure in five minutes
options.zh: 舌下含服硝酸甘油 0.4 mg，5 分钟后复测血压

options.en: Lay her flat to raise the blood pressure, then give 0.4 mg nitroglycerin SL
options.zh: 先让她平躺把血压抬上来，然后舌下含服硝酸甘油 0.4 mg

options.en: Have her take a dose from a nitroglycerin spray kept in the house for her husband
options.zh: 让她用家里给丈夫备用的硝酸甘油喷雾喷一次

questions.explanationEn: Nitroglycerin is contraindicated when the systolic blood pressure is below 110 mmHg, and the guideline warns that hypotension occurs frequently in the elderly and must be expected. At 96/58 she is already below the threshold, so B and C are unsafe; C compounds the error by using positioning to manufacture a blood pressure that meets the protocol, which is not how a contraindication is cleared. D administers a medication that is not prescribed to the patient and still violates the blood pressure contraindication. The correct management is supportive: oxygen to keep SpO2 at or above 94%, close monitoring, and continued transport.
questions.explanationZh: 收缩压低于 110 mmHg 时硝酸甘油属禁忌，考纲还特别提醒老年人使用后常出现低血压，必须预先防范。该患者血压 96/58，已经低于阈值，所以选项 B、C 都不安全；C 更是错上加错——靠改变体位「制造」出一个符合协议的血压，禁忌证不是这样排除的。选项 D 给的是并非为该患者处方的药物，而且同样违反血压禁忌。正确处理是支持治疗：氧疗维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%、密切监护、继续转运。
questions.sourceRef: BC Guidelines p.73 (Nitroglycerin contraindications and cautions); p.47 (Cardiac Chest Pain)
questions.evolutionEn: En route her blood pressure falls to 96/58 and she becomes more short of breath. She still denies pain but now describes a 4/10 'pressure' across her upper chest.
questions.evolutionZh: 转运途中血压降至 96/58 mmHg，气促加重。她仍然否认疼痛，但开始描述上胸部有 4/10 程度的「压迫感」。

questions.questionEn: The patient says: "I feel so silly. I'm sure it's just my sugar. Could you just help me back into bed and I'll phone my daughter in the morning?" What is the paramedic's most appropriate response?
questions.questionZh: 患者说：「我觉得自己好傻。我肯定只是血糖的问题。你们能不能就扶我回床上，我早上再打电话给女儿？」急救员最恰当的回应是什么？

options.en: "You may well be right — take two of your acetaminophen and call your family doctor when the office opens."
options.zh: 「您说的很可能没错——吃两片对乙酰氨基酚，等诊所开门再打给家庭医生吧。」

options.en: "Your symptoms could be a myocardial infarction, an aortic dissection or a pulmonary embolism, so we need serial troponins and a 12-lead."
options.zh: 「您的症状可能是心肌梗死、主动脉夹层或者肺栓塞，所以需要连续测肌钙蛋白并做 12 导联心电图。」

options.en: "You are not being silly, and you are not any trouble to us at all. Symptoms like yours can come from the heart, so we do need to take you to hospital by ambulance now."
options.zh: 「您一点也不傻，也完全没有给我们添麻烦。像您这样的症状可能是心脏引起的，所以我们现在确实需要用救护车送您去医院。」

options.en: "That's your decision. If you'd rather wait, we can help you into bed and your daughter can drive you in if it gets worse."
options.zh: 「这由您自己决定。如果您想再等等，我们可以扶您上床，万一加重了让女儿开车送您去。」

questions.explanationEn: Two things must both be true in a communication item: the tone must address the emotional concern the patient actually voiced, and the clinical instruction must be safe. Option C does both — it directly answers her worry about being silly and about being a bother, and it states plainly that she needs to go by ambulance. A and D are kind but leave a possible myocardial infarction at home or in a private car. B is clinically motivated but uses hospital jargon and investigations that are meaningless to the patient and outside the paramedic's scope, and it never actually tells her what to do.
questions.explanationZh: 沟通类题目必须同时满足两点：语气要回应患者真正说出口的情绪顾虑，临床指令必须安全。选项 C 两点都做到了——它直接回应了她「觉得自己傻」和「怕添麻烦」的心理，同时明确告诉她需要坐救护车去医院。A 和 D 语气友善，却把一个可能的心肌梗死患者留在家里或塞进私家车。B 出发点是临床安全，但用的是患者听不懂的医院术语和检查，而且这些既超出急救员权限，也始终没有告诉她该怎么做。
questions.sourceRef: COPR Study Guide v4.2 sample case (communication item); BC Guidelines p.47

passages.titleEn: Six-year-old with hives and wheeze at a birthday party
passages.titleZh: 生日派对上出现荨麻疹和哮鸣的六岁女童

profile.chiefComplaintEn: Swelling of the lips and difficulty breathing that began about 10 minutes after eating a cookie at a birthday party
profile.chiefComplaintZh: 在生日派对上吃了一块饼干约 10 分钟后开始出现嘴唇肿胀和呼吸困难
profile.pastMedicalHxZh: 已知花生过敏；轻度哮喘
profile.medicationsEn: Salbutamol MDI as needed; an epinephrine auto-injector is prescribed but was left at home
profile.medicationsZh: 必要时使用沙丁胺醇定量吸入器；医生开过肾上腺素自动注射笔，但今天落在家里没带
profile.firstVitalsEn: HR 150; RR 36; BP 82/48; SpO2 90% on room air; weight 20 kg
profile.firstVitalsZh: 心率 150 次/分；呼吸 36 次/分；血压 82/48 mmHg；室内空气下 SpO2 90%；体重 20 kg
profile.physicalFindingsEn: Urticaria over the face, neck and trunk; swollen lips and tongue; audible wheeze with widespread expiratory wheezes on auscultation; anxious and sitting forward; skin initially flushed, now becoming pale
profile.physicalFindingsZh: 面部、颈部和躯干出现荨麻疹；嘴唇和舌头肿胀；可闻及喘鸣，听诊双肺弥漫呼气相哮鸣音；表情焦虑、身体前倾；皮肤先是潮红，现在开始变苍白
profile.otherInformationEn: A parent gave her two puffs of her own salbutamol inhaler with no improvement. Her last reaction, two years ago, required an emergency department visit.
profile.otherInformationZh: 家长已经给她用自己的沙丁胺醇吸入器吸了两下，没有任何改善。她上一次过敏发作是在两年前，当时需要去急诊科处理。

questions.questionEn: Which condition is this patient most likely suffering from?
questions.questionZh: 这名患儿最可能出现的是哪一种情况？

options.en: An acute asthma exacerbation
options.zh: 急性哮喘发作

options.en: Foreign body airway obstruction
options.zh: 气道异物梗阻

options.en: Anaphylaxis
options.zh: 过敏性休克（anaphylaxis）

options.en: A panic attack with hyperventilation
options.zh: 惊恐发作伴过度通气

questions.explanationEn: The BC anaphylaxis criteria are all present: exposure to a known allergen, signs of anaphylaxis across more than one system (respiratory distress with wheeze, urticaria, angioedema of the lips and tongue), and an unstable picture with a blood pressure of 82/48. Asthma is the deliberate near-miss because she is a known asthmatic and is wheezing, but wheeze alone does not explain hives, lip and tongue swelling, or hypotension, and her own bronchodilator has failed. There was no choking episode, and hypotension with urticaria is not a panic attack.
questions.explanationZh: BC 考纲的过敏性休克（anaphylaxis）判定条件全部满足：接触了已知过敏原、出现累及一个以上系统的过敏体征（呼吸窘迫伴哮鸣、荨麻疹、唇舌血管性水肿），并且血压 82/48 属于不稳定。哮喘是刻意设置的「差一点就对」的干扰项——她确实有哮喘史也确实在喘，但单纯哮鸣无法解释荨麻疹、唇舌肿胀和低血压，而且她自己的支气管扩张剂已经无效。本例没有呛咳异物的过程，低血压加荨麻疹也绝不是惊恐发作。
questions.sourceRef: BC Guidelines p.55 (Anaphylaxis indications and signs)

questions.questionEn: What is the correct first dose of epinephrine for this 20 kg child?
questions.questionZh: 对这名体重 20 kg 的患儿，肾上腺素的首剂应该是多少？

options.en: 0.2 mg IM (0.01 mg/kg), which may be repeated every 5 minutes up to 3 times
options.zh: 0.2 mg 肌注（按 0.01 mg/kg 计算），每 5 分钟可重复一次，最多重复 3 次

options.en: 0.5 mg IM, the standard adult anaphylaxis dose
options.zh: 0.5 mg 肌注，即成人过敏性休克的标准剂量

options.en: 0.2 mg IV given slowly over one minute
options.zh: 0.2 mg 静脉推注，1 分钟内缓慢推完

options.en: 0.02 mg IM (0.001 mg/kg)
options.zh: 0.02 mg 肌注（按 0.001 mg/kg 计算）

questions.explanationEn: The paediatric dose is 0.01 mg/kg IM to a maximum of 0.5 mg, and it may be repeated up to three times. For 20 kg that is 0.2 mg. Option B gives an adult dose to a child; option C uses a route that is not authorized for a PCP in this protocol — epinephrine is given intramuscularly; option D is a tenfold underdose. There are no absolute contraindications to epinephrine in a life-threatening situation such as anaphylaxis, so her asthma history is not a reason to hesitate.
questions.explanationZh: 儿童剂量为 0.01 mg/kg 肌注，最大不超过 0.5 mg，最多可重复 3 次。体重 20 kg 即 0.2 mg。选项 B 是把成人剂量用在儿童身上；选项 C 用的给药途径在该协议下不属于 PCP 权限——肾上腺素这里是肌注给药；选项 D 少了十倍。在过敏性休克这类危及生命的情况下，肾上腺素没有绝对禁忌证，所以她的哮喘病史不构成犹豫的理由。

questions.questionEn: What is the most appropriate next step?
questions.questionZh: 接下来最恰当的一步是什么？

options.en: Give a second dose of epinephrine immediately
options.zh: 立刻再给一剂肾上腺素

options.en: Give diphenhydramine before any further bronchodilator
options.zh: 在给任何支气管扩张剂之前先给苯海拉明（diphenhydramine）

options.en: Sit her fully upright and walk her out to the ambulance to save time
options.zh: 让她完全坐直，并让她自己走到救护车上以节省时间

options.en: Treat the remaining bronchospasm with nebulized salbutamol 5 mg while keeping her supine and continuing transport
options.zh: 用沙丁胺醇 5 mg 雾化处理残留的支气管痉挛，同时让她保持仰卧位并继续转运

questions.explanationEn: The BC anaphylaxis guideline is explicit that bronchospasm is treated with salbutamol only after epinephrine has been given, which is exactly the situation here; the nebulized dose for a child over one year is 5 mg. The same guideline says to position the patient supine to support the blood pressure and not to walk the patient, which rules out C. A second epinephrine dose is given at five-minute intervals if the patient is not improving — she is improving, and only three minutes have passed. Diphenhydramine mitigates medium-term effects and is an adjunct; it does not take precedence over the bronchodilator.
questions.explanationZh: BC 过敏性休克指南写得很清楚：支气管痉挛要在肾上腺素给药之后才用沙丁胺醇处理，本例正是这种情形；一岁以上儿童的雾化剂量是 5 mg。同一份指南要求让患者仰卧以支撑血压，并且不要让患者自己走动，因此选项 C 被排除。第二剂肾上腺素的时机是间隔 5 分钟且患者没有改善——本例是在好转，而且才过了 3 分钟。苯海拉明用于减轻中期效应，属于辅助用药，不应排在支气管扩张剂前面。
questions.sourceRef: BC Guidelines p.55 (Anaphylaxis — PCP interventions); p.77 (Salbutamol paediatric dose)
questions.evolutionEn: Three minutes after the epinephrine she is calmer and her colour has improved, but she is still wheezing. Her blood pressure is 86/52 and her SpO2 is 92% on high-flow oxygen.
questions.evolutionZh: 给完肾上腺素 3 分钟后，她情绪平静了一些、面色也有改善，但仍在喘。血压 86/52 mmHg，在高流量氧疗下 SpO2 为 92%。

questions.questionEn: What is the priority action at this point?
questions.questionZh: 此时的首要处置是什么？

options.en: Administer diphenhydramine 25 mg to limit the histamine response
options.zh: 给苯海拉明 25 mg 以抑制组胺反应

options.en: Administer a second dose of epinephrine 0.2 mg IM and continue rapid transport
options.zh: 再给一剂肾上腺素 0.2 mg 肌注，并继续快速转运

options.en: Start a 20 mL/kg fluid bolus and hold any further epinephrine until the bolus is complete
options.zh: 先开始 20 mL/kg 的液体冲击，冲击完成前暂不给第二剂肾上腺素

options.en: Stop the ambulance and complete a detailed secondary assessment to find the cause of the deterioration
options.zh: 把救护车停下，完成一次详细的二次评估以查明恶化原因

questions.explanationEn: Epinephrine is the definitive drug for anaphylaxis and may be repeated every five minutes up to three doses; eight minutes have now passed and the patient is deteriorating, so the second dose is due. Diphenhydramine only mitigates medium-term effects and will not reverse airway swelling or shock. Fluid is indicated for persisting hypotension, but withholding epinephrine until a bolus finishes reverses the correct order. Option D is the classic wrong-priority trap — stopping a time-critical transport to do a detailed secondary assessment is a major deficiency in the practical exam and delays definitive care.
questions.explanationZh: 肾上腺素是过敏性休克的关键药物，每 5 分钟可重复一次、最多 3 剂；现在已经过去 8 分钟而且病情在恶化，第二剂到了该给的时候。苯海拉明只能减轻中期效应，无法逆转气道水肿或休克。液体复苏对持续低血压是有指征的，但把肾上腺素押后等冲击完成，等于把正确的先后顺序颠倒过来。选项 D 是典型的「优先级错误」陷阱——在时间紧迫的转运途中停车做详细二次评估，在实操考试里属于重大扣分项，并会延误确定性治疗。
questions.sourceRef: BC Guidelines p.66 (Epinephrine — repeat up to 3 times); p.55 (Anaphylaxis); COPR Study Guide (EMR sample profile, wrong-priority distractor)
questions.evolutionEn: Eight minutes after the first dose the wheeze has returned and worsened, she has become drowsy, her blood pressure is now 70/40 and her SpO2 is 88% on high-flow oxygen.
questions.evolutionZh: 首剂给药 8 分钟后，哮鸣重新出现并加重，患儿变得嗜睡，血压降至 70/40 mmHg，高流量氧疗下 SpO2 为 88%。
